_README: MINIMAL real-A6 config for the viam:ethercat:a6-servo motor model (#64). The
companion to a6-hardware.example.json -- that one spells out the full PDO map
as an ADVANCED override; THIS one omits it and lets the driver DERIVE the
standard CiA402 map from control_mode (#61). This is all a conformant CiA402
drive needs: the required identity/motor facts + the A6's non-default hardware
bits. NO rxpdo/txpdo (derived) and NO move-complete tolerances (defaulted).
DERIVED per control_mode (standard CiA402 objects, index:subindex decimal):
velocity gate off (noise-robust position-delta). Override either only if needed.
!!! CONFIRM counts_per_rev + the DC/sync bits against THIS drive's ESI + the
motor nameplate before ENERGIZING. require_realtime defaults true (needs
name: servo

attributes._comment_mode: control_mode PP (GoTo/GoFor) | PV (SetRPM) | switchable (both, runtime PP<->PV). For "switchable" the derived map adds 0x6060 so the driver auto-selects PP for GoTo and PV for SetRPM.
attributes._comment_motor: Required motor facts. counts_per_rev = encoder counts per MOTOR rev at the drive's 1:1 electronic gear (A6 = 131072 = 2^17). motor_rated_current_amps = nameplate rated current (amps -> torque per-mille).
attributes._comment_a6_hw: A6-EC non-default hardware bits. The A6 supports ONLY DC sync (free-run -> AL 0x0027), on a 250 us SYNC0 granularity -- config data, set here. Its fault-reset (vendor SDO 0x2031:01=1), no-SYNC0 code (0x8700/Er74.1), and 0x603F gloss now live IN CODE in the viam:ethercat:a6-servo model (an A6ServoDriver subclass), NOT as config attributes (#15 item 2).
attributes._comment_optional: Everything else is OPTIONAL: rxpdo/txpdo (derived above), position_tolerance_counts (default counts_per_rev/720), velocity_threshold (default: position-delta), gear_ratio (1.0), peak_current_amps, loop_rate_hz (1000), quick_stop_decel (0x6085) for a controlled ramp-stop. Add only what a bench measurement or the app requires.
